class.name: CgameHitchCorrelator
class.brief_description: Explains frame hitches by scope growth and by the engine counter that moved with them.
class.description: [CgameHitchCorrelator] offers two complementary analyses. The static [method correlate] works offline on frame records (for example from [method CgameTrace.frames]): for every frame slower than a threshold it lists the scopes that grew most versus the rolling median of the preceding 60 frames and the counters that jumped. The instance method [method sample] works live: feed it the frame delta and the dictionary from [method read_counters] every frame. A frame much slower than the recent median is attributed to pipeline compilation, world streaming, VRAM growth or plain CPU cost.

method.name: cause
method.description: Classifies the change between two [method read_counters] results as [code]"shader_compile"[/code], [code]"streaming"[/code], [code]"vram"[/code] (growth above 64 MiB) or [code]"cpu"[/code].

method.name: correlate
method.description: Analyzes frame dictionaries with the keys [code]ms[/code], [code]scopes[/code] (microseconds per scope) and [code]counters[/code]. Returns one dictionary per hitch frame with [code]index[/code], [code]ms[/code], [code]baseline_ms[/code], [code]culprits[/code] (up to three scopes with [code]scope[/code], [code]usec[/code], [code]median_usec[/code], [code]growth_usec[/code]) and [code]counters[/code] (with [code]name[/code], [code]value[/code], [code]median[/code]).

method.name: describe
method.description: Returns a one-line summary of the hitch counts per cause.

method.name: median
method.description: Returns the median frame delta of the non-hitch frames seen by [method sample], in seconds.

method.name: read_counters
method.description: Reads the cheap engine counters used by [method sample]: [code]compiles[/code] (sum of the [RenderingServer] pipeline compilation counters), [code]cells[/code] (the given [param loaded_cells]) and [code]vram[/code] (video memory in bytes).

method.name: reset
method.description: Clears hitches, counts and the baseline.

method.name: sample
method.description: Feeds one frame. Returns [code]{time, ms, median_ms, cause}[/code] when the frame was a hitch, otherwise an empty dictionary. A hitch needs at least 30 baseline frames and a delta of at least 50 ms and 2.5 times the median. Hitch frames never enter the baseline.

members.member: The most recent hitch records returned by [method sample] (at most 32).
